title: Recipe 35 — Studio Walkthrough (the spec surface, with a UI on it)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Studio is a UI over the same specs and the same compiler — it owns no runtime of its own.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — the Playground tab makes real model calls.

groups.title: Beat 1 · a spec for Studio to open

beats.label: Type a harness
beats.cue: “Studio's Specs tab lists exactly this — files on disk, not rows in a database.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “The same lint the Wizard runs on every keystroke. One implementation, two front ends.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “And this is what the Graph tab draws — the IR, laid out. It isn't a separate model of your agent.”

verify.note: IR written to live/ir.json — the graph-layout input

beats.label: Open the IR
beats.cue: “GET /api/graph-layout/:specName hands the browser a layout over this.”

groups.title: Beat 2 · the API under the UI

beats.label: Run the playground smoke
beats.cue: “The recipe's Try it: every Playground probe, driven headlessly against the real backend contract.”

beats.label: Read the probe results
beats.cue: “Run-a-spec, cost-summary, graph-layout — the three endpoints the tabs are built on.”

beats.label: Type the recipe's plugin
beats.cue: “definePlugin — Studio's extension point. Drop the file in ~/.crewhaus/plugins/ and it appears as a tab.”

beats.label: Open it
beats.cue: “No build step, no registration call — a default export and a name.”

groups.title: One more thing · open the actual UI

beats.label: Start Studio
beats.cue: [manual] “Studio lives in the sibling crewhaus/utilities checkout, and this beat opens a browser — a human drives from here.”

verify.note: needs the sibling crewhaus/utilities checkout; serves the UI on :4243 and the backend on :4242

beats.label: Point it at a spec directory
beats.cue: [manual] “STUDIO_WORKSPACE is the only wiring — it's a file browser with a compiler attached.”

verify.note: a human clicks through the Specs, Wizard, Graph, and Playground tabs

beats.label: Read the tab tour
beats.cue: “Specs, Wizard, Graph, Playground, Cost — and what each one is actually calling underneath.”
